event.title: Claude Code Hackathon
event.subtitle: CC Foundations for Champions
event.location: Gates Foundation, Seattle — Lake Washington Room

sessions.title: Doors open & check-in
sessions.detail: Beverages available. Virtual attendees admitted to the Teams webinar.

sessions.title: Welcome & kickoff
sessions.detail: Opening remarks (Philippe-Alexandre Gilbert), event format, judging criteria & award categories.

sessions.title: Claude Code quickstart
sessions.detail: Condensed live primer led by Li-Tal Mashiach (Anthropic, in person).

sessions.title: Team check-in
sessions.detail: Confirm your pre-assigned team / breakout room and problem statement.

sessions.title: Build sprint 1
sessions.detail: Floating in-room support + monitored Teams channel for virtual teams.

sessions.title: Lunch break
sessions.detail: Quick all-hands connect at 12:00 first — virtual teams rejoin the main meeting to share where you are. Then Memphis Smokehouse buffet, available 11:45 AM – 2:00 PM outside the room. Beverages in-room all day.

sessions.title: Build sprint 2
sessions.detail: Keep building; final push toward submission.

sessions.title: Lightning demos
sessions.detail: Up to 10 teams, 2 minutes each, gong-timed. Remote teams demo over Teams.

sessions.title: Judging huddle & scoring
sessions.detail: Panel scores against the published rubric.

sessions.title: Awards & wrap
sessions.detail: Winners announced across all four categories. Keep-building call to action, then the Anthropic feedback survey.

beforeYouArrive: Install & authenticate Claude Code on your laptop
Join the hackathon Teams team and GitHub org (claude-code-hackathon-08-14-team)
Review your team assignment and problem statement
External guests: bring photo ID for building check-in
howTeamsWork: Aim for at least one experienced / GitHub-linked member per team
Not on a team? Ask a floor helper — solo-friendly tasks are available
Submit via the shared GitHub repo before the 2:10 PM deadline
